### You Are Worthy
Author: Karen Wingate
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-13-2026.html
Passage: Galatians 3:26
Points:
- Believers often struggle with feeling unworthy or needing to earn God's acceptance.
- Faith in Christ establishes every believer as a full and equal child of God.
- Social status, past failures, or earthly labels do not determine standing before God.
- In Christ, all believers share the same access, victory, and eternal inheritance.

### I Belong to Christ
Author: Kristen Terrette
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/i-belong-to-christ-wholly-loved-july-30.html
Passage: Galatians 3:29
Points:
- Earthly inheritances and family legacies pale in comparison to our divine birthright.
- Belonging to Jesus makes believers true spiritual heirs of God's promises to Abraham.
- Our eternal inheritance as children of the King is certain and secure.
- Believers are called to help expand God's family by sharing His gospel.
